当你需要让用户通过系统级扫码入口（如控制中心）直接扫码跳转到你的应用服务页时，应优先使用扫码直达能力，接入简单且用户体验最佳
当你需要在应用内集成扫码功能时，可根据是否需要自定义界面选择默认界面扫码或自定义界面扫码
当你需要对本地图片或图像数据中的码图进行识别，或者需要根据文本或字节数组生成码图时，Scan Kit提供了相应的图像识码和码图生成能力
对于H5场景中的扫码需求，Scan Kit也提供了对应的接入方案
集成应用内扫码入口以识别商品条码和二维码 / Add an in-app scanner to recognize barcodes and QR codes
实现扫一扫后自动解析结果并跳转到对应页面 / Implement scan-to-parse and navigate to the target page
从相册读取图片并识别其中的二维码内容 / Decode QR content from images picked from the gallery
生成用于分享链接或设备配网的二维码图片 / Generate QR images for sharing links or device onboarding
批量识别图片里的多个码值并返回结果列表 / Detect multiple codes in an image and return a result list
在自定义相机页面叠加扫码框并实时识别画面中的码 / Overlay a scan box on a custom camera view and detect codes in real time
接入连续扫码用于仓储盘点或门票核销 / Enable continuous scanning for inventory counting or ticket verification
保存生成的码图到相册或导出为图片文件 / Save generated code images to the gallery or export them as files
在Web页面中调用原生扫码能力并将结果回传H5 / Invoke native scanning from a web page and pass results back to H5
实现扫描结果去重和同码过滤，避免重复处理 / Implement duplicate scan filtering to avoid processing the same code twice
根据扫描内容识别URL、文本或Wi‑Fi配置信息 / Parse scanned content as URL, text, or Wi‑Fi configuration
调节扫码相机的闪光灯、对焦和缩放提升识别率 / Control flashlight, focus, and zoom to improve scan recognition
do_not_use_when: 需求是实现通用深度链接、URL跳转或跨端唤起，而不是识别/生成条码二维码；应使用 app-linking-kit / The need is generic deep linking, URL routing, or cross-device app invocation rather than barcode/QR scanning or generation; use app-linking-kit
需求是配置应用分享、分享面板或把内容分享到其他应用，而不是扫描码或生成码图；应使用 share-kit / The need is app sharing, share panels, or sending content to other apps rather than scanning codes or generating code images; use share-kit
需求是接入广告投放、广告归因或广告变现能力，而不是扫码识别；应使用 ads-kit / The need is ad delivery, attribution, or monetization capabilities rather than scan recognition; use ads-kit
需求是实现游戏登录、成就、排行榜或其他游戏服务，而不是扫码功能；应使用 game-service-kit / The need is game sign-in, achievements, leaderboards, or other game services rather than scanning features; use game-service-kit

需求是做场景感知、意图推荐或多设备场景协同，而不是相机/图片中的码识别；应使用 scenario-fusion-kit / The need is scene awareness, intent recommendation, or multi-device scenario orchestration rather than code recognition from camera/images; use scenario-fusion-kit
preconditions: 工程已集成Scan Kit对应SDK/依赖，且目标设备支持所选能力 / The project has integrated the Scan Kit SDK/dependencies and the target device supports the chosen capability
若使用相机扫码，module.json5已声明相机权限且用户已授权 / If camera-based scanning is used, camera permission is declared in module.json5 and granted by the user
若使用“扫码直达”，已按要求完成服务接入与相关配置 / If Scan-to-App is used, the service onboarding and required configuration have been completed
若处理本地图片或输出码图，应用具备相应文件访问/保存能力与可用路径 / If processing local images or outputting code images, the app has the necessary file access/save capability and a valid path
inputs: 扫码模式与能力类型（扫码直达/默认界面/自定义界面/图像识码/码图生成） / Scan mode and capability type (Scan-to-App/default UI/custom UI/image recognition/code generation)
待识别的图片URI、像素缓冲区或相机预览帧 / Image URI, pixel buffer, or camera preview frame to be recognized
待生成码图的文本或字节数组 / Text or byte array used to generate the code image
识别或生成参数（码制式、尺寸、颜色、是否连续扫码等） / Recognition or generation parameters (symbology, size, colors, continuous scan, etc.)

postconditions.statement: 代码中已接入至少一种Scan Kit能力调用，并与目标场景一致 / The code integrates at least one Scan Kit capability invocation matching the intended scenario
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify code/configuration that clearly invokes a Scan Kit capability (scan-to-app, default UI scan, custom scan, image recognition, or code generation) appropriate to the user's request?

postconditions.statement: 若涉及相机扫码，已补充权限声明或授权处理逻辑 / If camera-based scanning is involved, permission declaration or grant-handling logic has been added
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the changes implement camera scanning, do they also include camera permission declaration/configuration or runtime permission handling?

postconditions.statement: 扫码或识码结果已被应用消费，如跳转、展示、回调处理或错误处理 / Scan/recognition results are consumed by the app, such as navigation, display, callback handling, or error handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits show that scan or recognition results are handled in application logic, including success and optionally cancellation/error cases?

postconditions.statement: 若为码图生成，已产出可显示或保存的码图对象/文件并设置关键参数 / If code generation is implemented, a displayable or savable code image object/file is produced with key parameters set
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the edits generate a barcode/QR image, do they create an output image/file and set relevant generation parameters such as content, size, or colors?
